Morgan: quick heads-up — running the docs link scanner found two 404s in docs/kb/realtime-batching.md and a tiny grammar nit in docs/guides/prompt-best-practices.md. low effort PR? (I can open one if no takers)
Alejandra: I can grab the 404s. which URLs are failing?
Morgan: thanks! failing links: https://example-cdn/old-batch.png and an internal shortlink /kb/batch-tuning -> 404 in staging. grep: `grep -n "shortlink" docs/kb/realtime-batching.md`
Sam: if you replace the image with the rehosted one under `/assets/img/batching-v2.png` we should be fine — need to update alt text too.
Alejandra: ok i'll do image swap + update alt. will also replace the shortlink with canonical `/kb/batch-tuning-v2`
Jordan: ping me for CR after the PR — i'll squeeze it between reviews. also can we add a one-line changelog entry under docs/CHANGES.md?
Alejandra: sure. PR will include a changelog bullet and the small grammar tweak (fixed "it's" -> "its")
DocsBot: docs-link-scan ran: 2 failures found in staging on 2026-03-22 10:00 UTC
Morgan: perfect — thanks! @Jordan please review when you can. Alejandra LMK if you need help with the PR title or reviewers.
Alejandra: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — reviewers: @Jordan @Sam. Summary: swap image, fix shortlink, tiny grammar.
Jordan: LGTM on description, will review in ~30m :thumbsup:
Sam: quick nit — alt text should be 'Batching diagram (v2)', else looks good.
Alejandra: updated alt text and pushed. tagging y'all for review.
Jordan: approved and merged. deployed to staging. thanks team :tada:
Morgan: awesome, closing the loop. I've scheduled a docs-sweep for next week to catch similar shortlinks.
